+"""Visual servo controller for the single RoboCasa GR1 episode.
+
+Only camera images, calibrated depth, and robot proprioception are used.
+The commands below are absolute grip-site targets in the robot base frame.
+"""
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import numpy as np
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+OUT = Path('/app/output')
+CAMERAS = ['egoview', 'robot0_eye_in_left_hand', 'robot0_agentview_center']
+T = np.array([2.65, -2.175, 0.97])
+R = np.array([[0., -1., 0.], [1., 0., 0.], [0., 0., 1.]])
+
+def world_to_base(p):
+    return R.T @ (np.asarray(p, dtype=float) - T)
+
+def base_to_world(p):
+    return R @ np.asarray(p, dtype=float) + T
+
+def current_action(meta):
+    p = meta['proprio']
+    return np.array([p['now'][p['layout'].index('cmd_' + k)] for k in
+        ['right_x','right_y','right_z','right_rx','right_ry','right_rz',
+         'left_x','left_y','left_z','left_rx','left_ry','left_rz',
+         'right_little','right_ring','right_middle','right_index','right_thumb_flexion','right_thumb_rotation',
+         'left_little','left_ring','left_middle','left_index','left_thumb_flexion','left_thumb_rotation']], dtype=float)
+
+def submit(r, target, seconds=1.0, start=None, label='move', cameras=CAMERAS):
+    if start is None:
+        start = current_action(r.get_obs(cameras=[], video='none').meta)
+    n = max(1, round(seconds / r.spec()['control_dt']))
+    rows = np.linspace(start, target, n)
+    res = r.submit('ee_pose', rows, cameras=cameras, video='none', include_depth=True, note=label)
+    res.save(str(OUT / ('step_' + str(res.meta['calls']).zfill(3) + '_' + label)))
+    print(label, 'steps', res.meta['control_steps'], 'left', round(res.meta['time_left_s']), flush=True)
+    return res
+
+def pixel_to_world(meta, cam, depth, u, v):
+    K = np.array(meta['cameras'][cam]['intrinsic_cv'])
+    C = np.array(meta['cameras'][cam]['cam2world_gl'])
+    d = float(depth[-1, int(v), int(u)])
+    q = np.array([(u-K[0,2])*d/K[0,0], -(v-K[1,2])*d/K[1,1], -d, 1.])
+    return (C @ q)[:3]
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    r = Robot()
+    print(json.dumps(r.status(), indent=2))
*** End Patch"));
